name: Transthyretin
milestone: Identified as 'prealbumin' in blood (Kabat et al.)
blurb: Carries thyroid hormone and vitamin A in blood and spinal fluid.

misfolded.name: Transthyretin amyloid
misfolded.description: The four-part TTR complex falls apart and the pieces misfold into amyloid in nerves and heart. Tafamidis works by holding the complex together.

function: Thyroid hormone-binding protein. Probably transports thyroxine from the bloodstream to the brain

variants.note: Carried by about 3–4% of African Americans
